Players Committee card image of [[Careful Planning (V)]] (original printing), game text: “If your starting location was a system, deploy from Reserve Deck a related site (must be a battleground if the system is a non-battleground or Endor) with < 3 [Light Side Force] icons and up to three Effects that are always [Immune to Alter]. Place this Interrupt in Lost Pile.”
